family: The single total MOD3 family defined in proof.md Section 1: L = {x in {0,1}^* : the number of ones in x is divisible by 3}; f_n(x)=1 iff |x|_1 = 0 (mod 3) for every integer n>=0 (f_0=1). It is decided at every length by one fixed linear-time counter-mod-3 evaluator, and V(x,w)=1 iff w is empty and the evaluator accepts x, with witness bound W=0.
theorem: For this one total uniform polynomial-time family, hence in NP with empty witnesses, C_B2(f_n)>=2n-3 for every integer n>=2 in the full Li–Yang B2 model (proved even for circuits with free constant source nodes), hence C_B2(f_n)>=2n-o(n) at every sufficiently large integer length n=|x|.
